apdex.rationale: Initial API responsiveness target for a lightweight backend; revisit after stable production baseline data.

golden_metrics.name: throughput
golden_metrics.nrql: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production'

golden_metrics.name: latency
golden_metrics.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production'

golden_metrics.name: error_rate
golden_metrics.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production'

golden_metrics.name: saturation
golden_metrics.nrql: SELECT average(cpuPercent), average(memoryUsedPercent) FROM SystemSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com'

service_levels.name: Backend request availability
service_levels.good_event: Transaction events where error IS false
service_levels.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production'

service_levels.name: Backend request latency
service_levels.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE duration <= 0.75) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production'

service_levels.name: Backend error-free requests
service_levels.good_event: Transaction events where error IS false
service_levels.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production'

service_levels.name: Feed freshness
service_levels.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE workflow.feedRefresh.ageSeconds <= 900) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production'

review_after: Collect seven production days before tightening targets.
